beats.text: Last episode: one frame passed J1, then J2, 310 ns apart.
beats.zh: 上一集：同一帧先经过 J1，再经过 J2，相差 310 纳秒。

beats.text: People say EtherCAT is a ring: the frame goes round and comes back.
beats.zh: 大家都说 EtherCAT 是一个环：帧绕一圈再回来。

beats.text: But look at our line. One cable from the master, slave to slave, and the last one goes nowhere.
beats.zh: 可看看我们的总线：一根网线从主站出发，一个接一个，最后一个从站后面什么也没接。

beats.text: That is a line, not a ring. So where is the ring?
beats.zh: 这是一条线，不是环。那环在哪里？

beats.text: Open an Ethernet cable: eight wires, twisted into four pairs.
beats.zh: 剥开一根网线：8 根线，两两绞成 4 对。

beats.text: EtherCAT runs at 100 Mbit/s, and that speed uses only two of the pairs.
beats.zh: EtherCAT 跑 100 Mbit/s，这个速率只用其中 2 对。

beats.text: Pins 1 and 2: one pair that sends. Pins 3 and 6: one pair that receives.
beats.zh: 1、2 脚是一对，负责发；3、6 脚是一对，负责收。

beats.text: Both pairs work at the same time. This is called full duplex.
beats.zh: 两对同时工作，这叫全双工。

beats.text: Like a road with two lanes: traffic goes both ways at once, and never meets.
beats.zh: 就像一条双车道的路：两个方向同时通车，互不相撞。

beats.text: Now draw our line that way: every cable becomes two lanes.
beats.zh: 按这个样子重画我们的总线：每根网线都变成两条车道。

beats.text: The lane away from the master we call outgoing. The lane back we call return.
beats.zh: 离开主站的那条叫去程，回主站的那条叫回程。

beats.text: Three cables, so three outgoing lanes and three return lanes.
beats.zh: 三根网线，就有三条去程、三条回程。

beats.text: The question is now: what happens inside each slave, where the lanes meet?
beats.zh: 问题变成了：车道在每个从站里汇合，那里发生了什么？

beats.text: Every slave has a chip for EtherCAT, the ESC: EtherCAT Slave Controller.
beats.zh: 每个从站里有一颗专管 EtherCAT 的芯片，叫 ESC（EtherCAT 从站控制器）。

beats.text: Our ESCs have two ports. Port 0 faces the master: IN. Port 1 faces away: OUT.
beats.zh: 我们的 ESC 有两个口。口 0 朝着主站，标 IN；口 1 背着主站，标 OUT。

beats.text: A frame arriving at port 0 goes through the processing unit, then out of port 1.
beats.zh: 从口 0 进来的帧，先经过处理单元，再从口 1 出去。

beats.text: The processing unit reads and writes this slave's data in the frame, as it passes.
beats.zh: 处理单元就在帧经过时，读写帧里属于这个从站的数据。

beats.text: A frame arriving at port 1 skips it, and goes straight out of port 0.
beats.zh: 从口 1 进来的帧不经过它，直接从口 0 出去。

beats.text: So each slave works on the frame once, on the way out. The return trip is just forwarding.
beats.zh: 所以每个从站只在去程上处理一次这一帧，回程只是转发。

scenes.title: Turning around at a closed port

beats.text: Now the last slave, J2. Nothing is plugged into its port 1.
beats.zh: 再看最后一个从站 J2：它的口 1 上什么也没插。

beats.text: No cable means no link. The ESC sees that and closes the port.
beats.zh: 没插线就没有链路。ESC 发现了，就把这个口关掉。

beats.text: A closed port does not send. The frame is passed inside the chip to the next port instead.
beats.zh: 关闭的口不往外发，帧在芯片内部直接交给下一个口。

beats.text: For two ports, the next port after 1 is port 0. So the frame turns around and heads home.
beats.zh: 两个口的芯片，口 1 的下一个就是口 0。于是帧掉头，往回走。

beats.text: Like a dead-end street with a turning circle at the end.
beats.zh: 就像一条死胡同，尽头有个掉头的圆环。

beats.text: Nobody configured this. It happens because the cable is missing.
beats.zh: 这不需要谁去配置：没插线，它就自动发生。

beats.text: Now follow one frame from the master, with a stopwatch.
beats.zh: 现在拿着秒表，跟着一帧从主站出发。

beats.text: Guess first: how long until its first bit is back at the master?
beats.zh: 先猜：它的第一个比特要多久才回到主站？

beats.text: 10 ns: it reaches slave 1. 2 m of cable at a simulated 5 ns per metre.
beats.zh: 10 纳秒：到达从站 1。2 米网线，模拟的每米 5 纳秒。

beats.text: 320 ns: it reaches J1. 630 ns: it reaches J2.
beats.zh: 320 纳秒到 J1，630 纳秒到 J2。

beats.text: Each slave on the way out adds 305 ns, the ET1100 datasheet's average through the processing unit.
beats.zh: 去程上每个从站添 305 纳秒：ET1100 数据手册里经过处理单元的平均值。

beats.text: 935 ns: it leaves J2 again, turned around.
beats.zh: 935 纳秒：掉过头，又从 J2 出来。

beats.text: On the way back each slave adds 265 ns: forwarding alongside the unit is a little quicker.
beats.zh: 回程每个从站添 265 纳秒：从旁边转发，稍快一点。

beats.text: 1205 ns: it leaves J1. 1475 ns: it leaves slave 1.
beats.zh: 1205 纳秒离开 J1，1475 纳秒离开从站 1。

beats.text: 1485 ns: back at the master. About 1.5 µs for the whole trip.
beats.zh: 1485 纳秒：回到主站。整趟约 1.5 微秒。

beats.text: The cable and chip delays are simulated. The path the frame takes is what the chip's rules say.
beats.zh: 网线和芯片延迟是模拟的；帧走哪条路，是芯片规则决定的。

beats.text: Now look at the path: out on every outgoing lane, back on every return lane.
beats.zh: 现在看这条路径：去程走遍每一条去程车道，回程走遍每一条回程车道。

beats.text: It never doubles back halfway, and no lane is used twice.
beats.zh: 中途不折返，也没有哪条车道走两次。

beats.text: That is a ring. It is just folded inside the cables.
beats.zh: 这就是一个环，只不过折叠在网线里面。

beats.text: The master needs one Ethernet port: it sends on one pair and receives on the other.
beats.zh: 主站只需要一个网口：一对线发，另一对线收。

beats.text: And every frame visits every slave, in the same order, every time.
beats.zh: 而且每一帧都按同样的顺序经过每一个从站，每一次都一样。

beats.text: Now cut the cable between J1 and J2.
beats.zh: 现在把 J1 和 J2 之间的网线剪断。

beats.text: Guess: how many slaves will the master find? And where does the frame turn around?
beats.zh: 猜一猜：主站会找到几个从站？帧在哪里掉头？

beats.text: J1's port 1 loses its link, so it closes. The frame now turns at J1.
beats.zh: J1 的口 1 失去链路，于是关闭。帧现在在 J1 掉头。

beats.text: The master finds 2 slaves. J2 may still be powered, but no frame reaches it.
beats.zh: 主站找到 2 个从站。J2 也许还通着电，但没有帧能到它那里。

beats.text: The trip is shorter: 905 ns instead of 1485 ns.
beats.zh: 行程变短：905 纳秒，而不是 1485 纳秒。

beats.text: Nothing crashed, and nothing needed reconfiguring. The ring just got shorter.
beats.zh: 没有崩溃，也不用重新配置：环只是变短了。

beats.text: How does the master know? Two small pieces of SOEM.
beats.zh: 主站怎么知道的？SOEM 里有两小段代码。

beats.text: First it counts: one broadcast read, and every slave it passes adds 1 to a counter in the frame.
beats.zh: 先数人数：发一个广播读，每经过一个从站，帧里的计数器就加 1。

beats.text: The counter comes back as 3, or as 2 after the cut. Episode 3 says more about this counter.
beats.zh: 计数器回来是 3，剪断后是 2。这个计数器第 3 集还会细讲。

beats.text: Then it asks each slave for register 0x0110, DL Status: the state of its ports.
beats.zh: 然后逐个读从站的寄存器 0x0110，DL 状态，也就是各个口的状态。

beats.text: Two bits per port. Pattern 10 means: open, and communication established with the neighbour.
beats.zh: 每个口两位。10 这个组合的意思是：打开了，而且和邻居建立了通信。

beats.text: SOEM tests each port in turn, and remembers the open ones.
beats.zh: SOEM 挨个检查每个口，把打开的口记下来。

beats.text: Intact line: slave 1 and J1 show both ports open, J2 only port 0.
beats.zh: 完整的总线：从站 1 和 J1 两个口都开，J2 只开口 0。

beats.text: After the cut, J1 shows only port 0. The open ports tell SOEM where the line ends.
beats.zh: 剪断后，J1 也只剩口 0 开着。哪些口开着，就告诉了 SOEM 总线在哪里结束。

beats.text: Some slaves have 3 or 4 ports, so the cable can branch.
beats.zh: 有些从站有 3 个或 4 个口，网线就能分叉。

beats.text: Same rule: each port hands the frame to the next. It walks every branch in turn, then comes home: a tree is still one ring.
beats.zh: 还是同一条规则：每个口把帧交给下一个口。帧把每条支路挨个走完再回家：树形也还是一个环。

beats.text: One: every cable is two lanes, one pair each way, both at once.
beats.zh: 一、每根网线都是两条车道：一对线一个方向，同时工作。

beats.text: Two: the slave works on the frame on the way out. A port with no cable closes, and the frame turns around.
beats.zh: 二、从站在去程上处理帧；没插线的口自动关闭，帧在那里掉头。

beats.text: Three: so a line of slaves is already a ring, and a cut only makes it shorter.
beats.zh: 三、所以一串从站本身就是一个环；剪断只会让环变短。

beats.text: A line has 5 slaves. The cable after slave 3 is cut.
beats.zh: 一条总线有 5 个从站，从站 3 后面的网线断了。

beats.text: How many slaves does the master find? Which port closes?
beats.zh: 主站能找到几个从站？哪个口会关闭？

beats.text: 3 slaves. Slave 3's port 1 closes, and the frame turns around there.
beats.zh: 3 个从站。从站 3 的口 1 关闭，帧在那里掉头。

beats.text: Next: the frame is back after 1.5 µs. But even the shortest frame takes 5.8 µs to send.
beats.zh: 下一集：帧 1.5 微秒就回来了，可最短的帧发出去也要 5.8 微秒。

beats.text: Its head is home before its tail has left. Episode 3: processing on the fly.
beats.zh: 帧头回到了家，帧尾还没出门。第 3 集：边走边处理。
